milestones.description: Season hub and match journal system initialized. Squad of 36 fully catalogued.
Pre-season: 4W from 4. EIC undefeated (2W). Youth Tournament SF win in AET. Moore and Lord emerging as standouts. Next: EIC Group Stage vs SD Huesca.

Pre-season complete. Squad of 36 senior players catalogued. Eight loan players (Revan, Coady, Ashfield, Lee, Cannon, Mullin, Hardie, Faal) returned to parent clubs. Youth Academy formalised with 6 players. Board mandate: automatic promotion to Premier League.
D. Ward transfer listed (£925k valuation). D. Scarr transfer listed (£975k valuation). A. James loan listed.
N. Broadhead named Player of the Match vs Southampton (3A, 7.8). Keillor-Dunn 2G/1A (8.4), Moore 2G (8.2). Carabao Cup tie vs Preston North End incoming.

Youth Academy intake: V. Martini (CB, Italy, 16, pot 72-94), E. Bianchi (CDM, Italy, 16, pot 66-88), J.C. Vargas (CAM, Argentina, 16, pot 82-94), N. Matthews (RW, England, 15, pot 68-92). Also in academy: A. Gassner (GK, 16), J. Lord (LB, 17, pot 69-89), V. Horne (RB, 17), P. Dijkgraaf (CDM, 17), S. Hak (RW, 15). Total: 10 players.
Y. Amrizi (21, ST/LW) signed as a free agent — £6.5m market value, £0 fee, immediate first-team involvement. Debut off the bench vs Sheffield Wed (72', LW, 6.4 rating).
T. O'Connor placed on the transfer list. Player has told the club he welcomes the move — morale unaffected (Happy).
Carabao Cup Round 2 exit — lost 1-0 at home to Blackburn Rovers. Championship focus resumes.
MD4 LOSS: 0-2 at Millwall. First Championship defeat of the season. Described as a mess — no creative output, defensive frailties exposed. Record: W2 D1 L1.
C. Burton (GK, 28) sold to AFC Hermannstadt for $570k. Frees GK slot; D. Ward and A. Okonkwo remain as the senior pair.
M. James (CDM/CM, 33, declining OVR 69→68) sold to Middlesbrough for $760k. Senior midfield depth thins — reinforcement needed.
JL. Rodriguez signed as a free agent, £36k/w. Attribute details pending screenshots.

MD5 WIN: 4-0 vs QPR. JL Rodriguez debut brace (23'/29') + assist in 70 mins — 9.6 rating. Back to 2nd in Championship (W3 D1 L1, 10pts). Broadhead leads EFL Championship assists chart (4A in 5 apps). Moore and Keillor-Dunn both on 4G in league.
Youth Academy: S. Ortega (LW, Argentina, 17, OVR 63, pot 68-92) catalogued. Total: 11 players.
MD6 WIN: 3-1 away at Norwich City. Moore, Amrizi (sub) and Dobson (sub) on the scoresheet. Amrizi MoM with a goal and an assist. Record: W4 D1 L1 in the league.

MD7 WIN: 3-0 at home vs Derby County. Keillor-Dunn, Rodriguez and Kaboré (a standout header) scored; Okonkwo clean sheet earns MoM. Wrexham now 2nd in the Championship: P7 W5 D1 L1, GF18 GA6, 16 pts, one point behind league-leaders Ipswich.
Youth Academy: J.C. Vargas updated to OVR 61 (POT 83-94, CAM). S. Ortega's PlayStyle confirmed as Acrobatic. Academy remains at 11 players.
MD8 WIN: 3-0 away at Leicester City. Windass, Moore (MoM, 7.9) and Rodríguez struck; clean sheet on the road. Record: P8 W6 D1 L1, GF21 GA6, 19 pts.
MD9 WIN: 4-2 at home vs Birmingham City. Rodríguez brace (MoM, 8.4) plus Broadhead and Cadamarteri goals overturned a 2-2 scare from Fujimoto and Klarer. Record: P9 W7 D1 L1, GF25 GA8, 22 pts.

T. O'Connor (CB/CDM, OVR 65, age 26) sold to Kocaelispor for $1.25M — rated Excellent Deal (market value $925k, best possible $1.4M). Deal completes January 2026. $913,875 added to transfer budget. Separate: C. Burton transfer talks with Zagłębie Lubin broke down 05/10.

MD10 LOSS: 4-1 at Stoke City. Wrexham led 1-0 at halftime (Moore 16') then conceded four in the second half — Thomas 61', Cissé 74', Phillips 87', Manhoef 90'. Hyam yellow 67' forced early defensive sub (Cleworth). Okonkwo 5.2 (season-low). Beaten by opponent 11-2. Record: P10 W7 D1 L2, GF26 GA12, 22 pts. Wrexham top of Championship.
MD11 DRAW: 0-0 at home vs Oxford United. Dominant but couldn't break the low block — Kaboré named MoM. Record: P11 W7 D2 L2, GF26 GA12, 23 pts.

MD12 LOSS: 0-2 away at Middlesbrough. T. Conway 60'/80' brace — both goals in second half, 0-0 at HT. Wrexham had 3 shots (1 on target), xG 0.6 vs 2.9. Tackle success 17% vs 54%. Beaten by opponent 11-4. Kaboré and Hyam best on night (both 7.0). Record: P12 W7 D2 L3, GF26 GA14, 23 pts.

MD13 WIN: 3-2 at home vs Coventry City. K. Moore hat-trick (4'/45'/74') — Man of the Match 8.5. Coventry led 1-2 after 21 minutes; Moore levelled on stroke of HT then completed the comeback with the winner at 74'. Windass missed penalty 61'. Windass (1 AST), Kaboré (1 AST), Broadhead (1 AST). Yellow: Broadhead 90'. Poss 40-60%, xG 3.2-1.2. Record: P13 W8 D2 L3, GF29 GA16, 26 pts.

MD18 WIN: 3-0 vs Blackburn Rovers at home. Broadhead 18', JL Rodriguez 55', O'Brien 62'. Controlled from start to finish. MoM: O'Brien. Record: P18 W11 D3 L4, GF42 GA20, 36 pts.
MD19 WIN: 4-3 away at Preston. Miraculous comeback. Moore 16', Broadhead 66', JL Rodriguez 83', Amrizi 93' (stoppage time winner). Record: P19 W12 D3 L4, GF46 GA23, 39 pts.
MD20 DRAW: 2-2 away at Hull City. Moore and Amrizi cancelled out an early two-goal deficit. Record: P20 W12 D4 L4, GF48 GA25, 40 pts.

D. Scarr sold to BSC Young Boys for $1,170,000 — personal terms agreed, deal completes when the transfer window opens. Corrects the record: the Gil Vicente FC deal logged 2025-08-15 fell through in negotiations and never completed; this Young Boys deal is the confirmed sale.

MD21 WIN: 3-2 vs Watford at home. C. Doyle yellow 30', red 51' (conceded a penalty in the process) — Wrexham played the rest of the match a man down, then scored three in the closing stages (Amrizi 75', Windass 82', Broadhead 90+4') to complete the comeback after Kjerrumgaard's 88th-minute leveler. Doyle handed a 1-match ban. Record: P21 W13 D4 L4, GF51 GA27, 43 pts. 2nd in Championship, 8 points behind Ipswich.

MD22 WIN: 2-1 away at Swansea City. Eom Ji Sung put Swansea ahead 34', but two late goals — Windass 88', Amrizi 90' (super sub, on 80' for Moore) — sealed it. Record: P22 W14 D4 L4, GF53 GA28, 46 pts. 2nd in Championship, 8 points behind Ipswich.

MD23 WIN: 4-3 vs Sheffield Utd at home. K. Moore brace (40'/51'), J. Rodríguez 75', Y. Amrizi 84'. SHU levelled at 2-2 then went ahead 2-3 before the final surge. Record: P23 W15 D4 L4, GF57 GA31, 49 pts. 2nd in Championship, 5 points behind Ipswich.
O. Rathbone personal terms agreed with Coventry City — $1,800,000 fee, deal completes when January window opens. Board allocating $1,332,900 to transfer budget.

Youth Academy Rush Tournament QTR WIN: 8-0 vs Blackburn Rovers. Dijkgraaf MoM (10.0, 2A). Matthews (10.0, 2A), Martini (3G, 10.0), Webber GK (9.6). Scorers: Ortega ×2, Lord, Matthews, Martini ×3, Dijkgraaf. New tournament — not a continuation of the Nov 2025 sweep.

Rodríguez PotM (9.6, 2G 2A). Record: P25 W17 D4 L4, GF66 GA33, 55 pts. 2nd in Championship, 1 point behind Ipswich (56).
FA CUP ROUND 3 WIN: 3-0 away at Leicester City. JL Rodriguez 10', Broadhead 45', Moore 78' (MoM). Controlled from start to finish. Wrexham advance to face Notts County on Feb 14.
MD29 WIN: 1-0 at home vs Norwich. JL Rodriguez 65' the only goal in a comfortable evening. MoM: Amelia.
Sam Smith (ST) sold to FC Kobenhavn for $1,900,000. Board allocated $1,410,180 to transfer budget.
Wrexham TOP OF THE TABLE for the first time all season — MD29 win over Norwich moves them above Ipswich, P27 W19 D4 L4 GF69 GA33 GD+36, 61 pts, 1 point clear of Ipswich (60 pts, P27).

MD29 WIN: 4-1 at home vs Leicester City. Rodríguez 38'/78' and Moore 45'/65' either side of Ayew's 28' leveler for Leicester — 2-1 at HT, comfortable from there despite Leicester dominating possession (62%). 13 shots to 6, 5.7 xG to 2.3. MoM: J. Rodríguez. Record: P29 W21 D4 L4, GF73 GA34, GD+39, 67 pts. 1st in Championship, 4 points clear of Ipswich (60 pts, P28).
